_design: Kit overlord ('elegant violence', M. Bison / Rugal). Ganondorf dair timing (UFD: startup 16, active 16-18, total 44 -> anim active 14-16, FAF 42) and its shape (knees tucked to the chest, both feet driven straight down); M. Bison head-stomp upper body: the arms rise and cross above the head through the startup, then fold on the chest (Bison's crossed arms) as the feet strike, and stay folded. Aerial: no idle entry, frame 0 already in the air tuck. No owner Step poses: the poses are authored data (author block), v1 for the owner's judgement. v1b (owner refs IMG_9040/9041 seen): arms folded tight and high on the chest, hands on the opposite upper arm; toes pointed at the stomp. v2 (2026-11-02): owner's Cascadeur key poses (Saved/AnimPipeline/overlord_dair_owner.casc, frames 15 and 23, read with casc_to_author.py; data in Saved/AnimPipeline/dair_v2/owner_poses_cascadeur.json) replace the anticipation and the stomp: owner 15 (tight ball, knees to the chest, forearms crossed in front of the face) -> anim 12, held and compressed to 13; owner 23 (straight vertical body leaning back, legs together, crossed arms high on the chest) -> anim 14, so the whole extension lands ON the first hitbox frame. Ganondorf timing kept (owner). Villain hand (open, fingers straight and together) at the anticipation, as asked. Owner rule: 'too much is just right' (Sakurai): toes pointed harder than his pose (-45). Clearance fix: crossed forearms 9-16 cm further forward at 12-13 (right in front of the left), head tuck 35% less; folded hands 3-6 cm off the chest in the recovery. Clearance pass 2: right forearm 5 cm above the left at 12-13, elbows wider; folded hands 5 cm further off the chest from 14. v3 (owner review of v2): arms, trunk and legs move as one: the arms travel relative to the trunk on every segment (low at the sides -> wide and rising at 6 -> crossing at chest height at 10 -> owner's crossed forearms in front of the face at 12 -> pushed up at 13 -> slammed down onto the chest at 14 with the legs), the trunk curls progressively (0 -> 6 -> 10 -> 12) instead of all at once. Head lag removed (part_delays head 0): the head reached its stomp pose one frame after the hit, so it snapped after the hitstop; hitstop_snap now counts the head's turn (20 cm lever). v4 (owner timing, replaces the GIF timing): initial pose almost upright, one knee up, arms open, hands open (0) -> extreme charge reached at 5 (owner 15) -> charge held and still tightening to 11 -> release starts at 12-13 (still reads as the charge) -> stomp lands on 14 (active 14-16) -> stomp held to 30 with a small settle -> recovery to 42. Slow, heavy move. Charge hold is alive: 5->11 the feet tuck 8 cm higher, the hands rise 8 cm, the trunk curls 6 deg, all together. Release spread 11->14 (owner: a slow move takes a few frames to let the force go): 15% at 12, 42% at 13, the last and largest 58% lands on 14. Owner: the first frame is already drawn in and loaded (55% of the way to the charge, arms pulled back with elbows behind), so 5 extremises a loaded pose. Owner: hitbox from anim frame 15 (16th frame); the charge hold runs to 12, release 12->15; charge poses more drawn in (feet +5 cm, trunk -6 deg). Frame 0 (owner: a sharp start, not already the charge): legs half drawn, trunk 30% curled, arms flung open wide and low behind the shoulders with open hands; 3: the arms sweep above the head and start crossing on the way; 5: the charge. Owner: knees stay in front, tucked to the chest through the charge (knee pole forward, feet under the hips, the hold creeps forward not up); key 2 keeps both arms rising wide together. Owner round: feet side by side at the stomp (no crossed ankles), villain hands bent 35 deg outward at the wrist 0-12. Owner review of that round: the arms got worse and the frog-open knees at 14 were right, so the arms at 3/5/12/13 (trunk at 3 included) and the knee poles at 13-14 are back to the previous round. Owner 02/11 22:43: charge (5, held to 12) = his Cascadeur f15, stomp (15-17, 31 with the 2 cm settle) = his f23, both read with casc_to_author (rescale, ratios 1.0 on these rigs) and locked in `approved`; pelvis height, fingers, wrist_out and the side-by-side feet stay the pipeline's. Why the charge had drifted: later rounds moved the hands +8 cm up and forward, added clavicle offsets and changed the trunk curl and head tuck by hand. Owner 02/11 22:56: the charge stays alive: only 5 is his f15 as is (locked); 12 = f15 plus the v4c hold deltas. Hold legs: feet tuck 6 cm forward and 6 up from 5 to 12 (co_motion: the legs must travel with the curling trunk). Owner 02/11 23:16: the stomp keeps his f23 feet (crossed ankles); the side-by-side exception is dropped for the dair.
_manual: Owner hand tweaks live on the additive 'Manuale' section of the rig track in /Game/AnimPipeline/Rig/LS_OverlordDAirV4_Build; animpipe build keeps them (cards/README.md). Arms are FK on this rig (arm_*_fk_ik_switch 0): key the *_fk_ctrl controls, the hand IK controls do nothing. Legs are IK.

poses.name: charge_load
poses.why: in-between 3-8: knees tuck 3 cm over the straight path so the charge stays alive (co_motion)

poses.name: windup
poses.why: in-between 8-14: hands wind up against the strike (15% of 14->15) before the release (co_motion, anticipation)

strike.why: both feet drive straight down together (design): the two legs are one striking limb, the arms are the hiders

exemptions.why: owner 02/11: open hands at the start (his initial pose) and the villain hand through the charge

owner's crossed arms: hands and forearms rest on the opposite arm and the chest (accepted contact), from the crossing at 3 on. Owner f23 (stomp, locked) folds them straight onto the chest: chest pairs spine_03-05 included (up to -3.7 cm at 15-34).

owner 02/11 22:39-22:44: the charge is his Cascadeur f15 pose, locked ('dovrebbe essere a posto'); on this mannequin its crossed forearms rest against the head (offline -2.5/-4.7 cm at 5-12, more in the 12->15 release between his two locked poses). Accepted contact, not a pose to fix.

_faf_why: owner 03/11 10:03: FAF 37 (anim frame; game 39 at 60 fps), charge stays at 3 as keyed. The approved block of the 03:02 import was written without his ok on the composite grid: removed until he approves it (owner rule 2); owner keys stay protected by origin/source.
_rules_note: 2026-11-03, calibrated on this build (owner keys, charge 3): frame 0 is the owner's air tuck, already 38-97% of the way to the charge per part, so frame_0 checks only the break from the idle (min 7.5 cm measured, max_frac 1.0); knees 23-36 cm in front through the charge 0-14 (behind by 2 cm only in the stomp, legs straight down); ankles 5.6 cm apart at the closest (feet together in the stomp), never crossed. villain_hand not declared: v4 keeps the template fists (no fingers/wrist_out in the card), owner to say if the dair wants the villain hand.
